name: blender metric millimeters setup for 3d print
goal: Configure Blender scene units and grid to millimeters for dimension-accurate hard-surface / 3D-print modeling.

source.title: How to 3D Model Using Blender - Easy Beginner Guide + Tips and Tricks

outputs.name: mm_scene
outputs.description: Scene with metric mm units and matching grid scale

constraints: Also set Viewport Overlays grid scale to 0.001

steps.action: Open Scene Properties; set Unit System to Metric.
Set Unit Scale to 0.001 and Length to Millimeters.
Open Viewport Overlays; set grid Scale to 0.001 so the grid matches mm.
Select object; press N for Sidebar; confirm Location/Rotation/Scale/Dimensions read in mm.
Reset object location to 0,0,0 if recentering at origin.

verification: Grid looks correct at mm scale
